triage.reason: Pinch stop took 13 ms vs 10 ms limit at -30 °C/9 V; a pinch not stopped in time can hurt a person.
Retained power ends after ~50 s instead of 60 s, so the window function is lost early. The reporter is unsure of the spec, but the later DR-1015 supports it.
97-104 ms is within 100 ms ±10 ms; information only.
False reversal of express close in the cold with no obstacle; wrong behaviour in normal use. The retry worked.
Comment typo only; the code is correct.
Same late pinch stop at -30 °C with low supply (14 ms vs 10 ms limit).
Sleep current 140 µA vs 100 µA limit. The likely cause is the transceiver staying in standby. No safety effect.
False reversal on rough road with nothing trapped (2 of 10 tries); wrong behaviour in normal use.
Overcurrent is not recorded as DTC B1A02 and the fault state stays 0; the diagnostic function is lost.
Too vague to judge: subjective clinic feedback with no measurement. More data needed; severity is provisional.
Same cold-weather reversal with no obstacle.
One open request is still executed after the model passed 140 °C; the next is refused. Limit missed, no direct safety effect.
Position drifts 3.5 mm after 200 cycles. This is degraded accuracy; no limit or safety effect is stated.
Motor stays on 180 ms after release at 16 V vs 100 ms limit; the overrun is voltage dependent. Limit missed. Anti-pinch is still active.
Same problem: retained power after ignition off is shorter than 60 s.
One WLC_Status frame was lost (200 ms gap) during diagnostic load. It is rare and differs from the within-limit jitter in DR-1003.
Documentation error in the draft manual only.
Hall signal loss is not detected (no plausibility check, no DTC) and the motor runs to the end stop. Position-based anti-pinch is effectively bypassed.
Same thermal block letting one opening through above 140 °C.
Express close is available while not normalized. Position and pinch protection are unreliable in that state, so a safety function is bypassed.
Unused variable and compiler warning only; no functional effect.
Diagnostic response up to 62 ms vs 50 ms limit in 3 of 100 requests, during motor start. Limit missed, no safety effect.
Same unexpected reversal over cobblestones with nothing trapped.
Reverse polarity protection diode D3 failed open and the controller is dead afterwards; function lost.
Undervoltage stop in 21 ms is within the 50 ms limit; information only.
Loud knock at the end stop, with no damage seen. End-stop behaviour is degraded; the report is subjective with no measurement.
Same problem: Hall loss is not detected or stored, and the window pushes into the seal without protection.
Inrush 14 A has no spec limit, so there is no failure. It is a requirement proposal only.
Same problem: overcurrent leaves fault state 0 and fault memory empty.

Reversal distance of 146 mm at 85 °C is below the 150 mm limit (162 mm at 23 °C). Limit missed; the report doesn't say whether 150 mm is a minimum, which is assumed. This is a different condition and cause from the timing defect DR-1001.
